children: New Delhi, Sept. 21 -- Refex Industries share price jumped over 4% on NSE in Monday's trading session. The stock rally came in ahead of board meeting and after the company bagged a new order worth Rs.160 crore.

Refex Industries shares opened at Rs.281.95 apiece today, as compared to previous close of Rs.271.85 on Friday last week. The stock opened 4.21% higher and extended its gains to more than 8%, hitting an intraday high of Rs.294.55. However, it pared some of the gains later to trade 3.99% higher.
